instruction: Candid office photograph, medium shot. In a modern office, the young Black man in a white dress shirt and maroon trousers (R1) stands on the left, looking down at the wooden desk while holding a blue folder. The older bearded man in a dark gray suit (R2) stands on the right, facing left and gesturing with his open left hand toward the desk, inviting R1 to sit. A laptop sits on the wooden desk in the foreground. The background features office shelves. The scene is illuminated by soft, natural indoor light, creating a professional and polite atmosphere.
